sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Virginia redrew its House of Delegates districts in 2011. The state applied a 55 percent racial floor to twelve districts. Appellants claim this practice violates the Equal Protection Clause. Appellees argue the district court correctly applied the law. The Supreme Court must define the legal standard for racial gerrymandering claims.
